mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name AS student_name, ss.status, ss.sub_status, s.last_response_at, s.completed_on FROM student s LEFT JOIN student_status ss ON ss.student_id = s.id ORDER BY s.id

SELECT h.id AS help_request_id, s.id AS student_id, s.name AS student_name, CONCAT(c.name, ' ', c.cohort) AS course_label, h.created_at, CONCAT(j.company_name, ' ', j.title) AS job_title, h.contact_method, h.memo FROM help_request h JOIN student s ON s.id = h.student_id JOIN course c ON c.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN recommendation_item ri ON ri.id = h.recommendation_item_id LEFT JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = ri.job_posting_id WHERE h.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC

SELECT a.id AS application_id, s.name AS student_name, CONCAT(j.company_name, ' ', j.title) AS job_title, a.submitted_at FROM application a JOIN student s ON s.id = a.student_id JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = a.job_posting_id WHERE a.status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY a.submitted_at ASC, a.id ASC

WITH ranked_passes AS ( SELECT r.student_id, ri.pass_note, ri.responded_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.student_id ORDER BY ri.responded_at DESC, ri.id DESC ) AS response_rank FROM recommendation_item ri JOIN recommendation r ON r.id = ri.recommendation_id WHERE ri.response = 'PASS' ) SELECT p.student_id, s.name AS student_name, p.pass_note FROM ranked_passes p JOIN student s ON s.id = p.student_id WHERE p.response_rank = 1 AND REGEXP_LIKE(p.pass_note, '[^[:space:]]') ORDER BY p.responded_at DESC, p.student_id ASC
